items.title: First-order lifts of Azumaya algebra endomorphisms are equivalent to preservation of the induced central Poisson bracket
items.author: Niels Lauritzen; Jesper Funch Thomsen
items.difficulty_reason: The criterion bridges noncommutative first-order deformation theory and the semiclassical central Poisson structure through f-twisted Hochschild bimodules, symmetric-cocycle vanishing for formally smooth commutative centers and Azumaya descent/restriction injectivity. Full author constant-rank/formal-smoothness/flat-lift hypotheses and all source-local obstruction arguments retained. It is an independent structural equivalence beyond the old general cocycle proposition.

primary.label: complete original main Azumaya lifting iff Poisson-preservation criterion and full hypotheses
